description: Generate images into a persistent React Flow canvas and open it in the Codex in-app browser.

interface.longDescription: Generate an image, save it into a project-backed React Flow canvas, and open the canvas in the Codex in-app browser. A shared local daemon serves original image files over HTTP and persists your layout.
